hooks.command: count=0; for d in "${HOME}/.codex/skills"/*/; do name="$(basename "${d%/}")"; case "${name}" in .*) continue;; esac; [ -L "${d%/}" ] || count=$((count+1)); done; for d in "${HOME}/.claude/skills"/*/; do name="$(basename "${d%/}")"; case "${name}" in .*) continue;; esac; [ -L "${d%/}" ] || count=$((count+1)); done; [ "${count}" -gt 0 ] && echo "unmanaged skills: ${count} — run 'roborepo skill adopt <name>' to version-control" || true
